arxiv-2012-12706.title: Singular solutions of the Yamabe problem in the Heisenberg group and their bifurcation
arxiv-2012-12706.creator: Claudio Afeltra
arxiv-2012-12706.description: Abstract We prove the existence of a homogeneous singular solution of the critical equation − Δ ​ u = u Q + 2 Q − 2 -\Delta u=u^{\frac{Q+2}{Q-2}} on the Heisenberg group H n H^{n} , where Q Q is the homogeneous dimension . In order to do this, we introduce a suitable concept of normal curvature for hypersurfaces.

arxiv-2106-13530.title: A geometrical model to describe the alpha dose rates from particulates of UO 2 in water
arxiv-2106-13530.creator: Angus Siberry, David Hambley, Anna M Adamska, Ross Springell
arxiv-2106-13530.description: Abstract A model investigating the role of geometry on the alpha dose rate of spent nuclear fuel has been developed. This novel approach utilises a new piecewise function to describe the probability of alpha escape as a function of particulate radius, decay range within the material, and position from the surface.

arxiv-2303-10536.title: TempT: Temporal consistency for Test-time adaptation
arxiv-2303-10536.creator: Onur Cezmi Mutlu, Mohammadmahdi Honarmand, Saimourya Surabhi, Dennis P. Wall
arxiv-2303-10536.description: Abstract We introduce Temp oral consistency for T est-time adaptation (TempT), a novel method for test-time adaptation on videos through the use of temporal coherence of predictions across sequential frames as a self-supervision signal. TempT is an approach with broad potential applications in computer vision tasks, including facial expression recognition (FER) in videos.

arxiv-2407-19657.title: Sustainable Task Offloading in Secure UAV-assisted Smart Farm Networks: A Multi-Agent DRL with Action Mask Approach
arxiv-2407-19657.creator: Tingnan Bao, Aisha Syed, William Sean Kennedy, Melike Erol-Kantarci
arxiv-2407-19657.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tingnan Bao, Aisha Syed, William Sean Kennedy, Melike Erol-Kantarci. The integration of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) with mobile edge computing (MEC) and Internet of Things (IoT) technology in smart farms is pivotal for efficient resource management and enhanced agricultural productivity sustainably. This paper addresses the critical need for optimizing task offloading in secure UAV-assisted smart farm networks, aiming to reduce total delay and energy consumption while maintaining robust security in data communications.

arxiv-2409-17550.title: A Simple but Strong Baseline for Sounding Video Generation: Effective Adaptation of Audio and Video Diffusion Models for Joint Generation
arxiv-2409-17550.creator: Masato Ishii, Akio Hayakawa, Takashi Shibuya, Yuki Mitsufuji
arxiv-2409-17550.description: Abstract In this work, we build a simple but strong baseline for sounding video generation. Given base diffusion models for audio and video, we integrate them with additional modules into a single model and train it to make the model jointly generate audio and video. To enhance alignment between audio-video pairs, we introduce two novel mechanisms in our model.

arxiv-2411-18996.title: Intersection of subspaces in A 2 A^{2} for a three-dimensional division algebra A A over a finite field
arxiv-2411-18996.creator: Daisuke Tambara
arxiv-2411-18996.description: Abstract Let A A be a three-dimensional nonassociative division algebra over a finite field F F . Let A A act on the space A 2 = A ⊕ A A^{2}=A\oplus A by left multiplication. For a nonzero vector v ∈ A 2 v\in A^{2} we have a three-dimensional subspace A ​ v Av in A 2 A^{2} .

arxiv-2502-17031.title: If Terao’s conjecture fails in ℙ 2 \mathbb{P}^{2} , then it fails in ℙ n > 2 \mathbb{P}^{n>2}
arxiv-2502-17031.creator: Piotr Pokora
arxiv-2502-17031.description: Abstract Using an elementary technique, we construct a first example of Ziegler pairs of hyperplane arrangements in ℙ 3 \mathbb{P}^{3} . Then, using this construction, we show how to obtain possible counterexamples to Terao’s freeness conjecture in ℙ n \mathbb{P}^{n} with n > 2 n>2 using arrangements of lines in ℙ 2 \mathbb{P}^{2} .

arxiv-2506-01568.title: Trajectory First: A Curriculum for Discovering Diverse Policies
arxiv-2506-01568.creator: Cornelius V. Braun, Sayantan Auddy, Marc Toussaint
arxiv-2506-01568.description: Abstract Being able to solve a task in diverse ways makes agents more robust to task variations and less prone to local optima. In this context, constrained diversity optimization has emerged as a powerful reinforcement learning (RL) framework to train a diverse set of agents in parallel.

arxiv-2510-20999.title: Bailey Pairs for the Tetrahedron Index
arxiv-2510-20999.creator: Ilmar Gahramanov a,c,d , Sinan Ulaş Öztürk a , Uveys Turhan a,b
arxiv-2510-20999.description: Abstract In this work, we develop new Bailey pairs for the pentagon identity satisfied by the tetrahedron index, expressible in terms of q q -series. Since the tetrahedron index underlies topological invariants of 3-manifolds and related knots, our construction may offer a new framework to deriving knot invariants through the Bailey chain.

britannica-1911-chamberlain.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-chamberlain.description: Article 'Chamberlain' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 5), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. The adverse effects of stress are well documented, yet many of underlying mechanisms remain unclear and controversial. Here we report that the anxiogenic properties of stress are

pmc-11382489.title: Stem cell-derived extracellular vesicles in premature ovarian failure: an up-to-date meta-analysis of animal studies
pmc-11382489.creator: Yan Luo, Jingjing Chen, Jinyao Ning, Yuanyuan Sun, Yitong Chai, Fen Xiao, Bixia Huang, Ge Li, Fen Tian, Jie Hao, Qiong Zhang, Jing Zhao, Yanping Li, Hui Li
pmc-11382489.description: BackgroundThere has been a significant surge in animal studies of stem cell-derived extracellular vesicles (EVs) therapy for the treatment of premature ovarian failure (POF) but its efficacy remains unknown and a comprehensive and up-to-date meta-analysis is lacking. Before clinical translation, it is crucial to thoroughly understand the overall impact of stem cell-derived EVs on POF.

pmc-11481566.title: Hypoxic glioma-derived exosomal miR-25-3p promotes macrophage M2 polarization by activating the PI3K-AKT-mTOR signaling pathway
pmc-11481566.creator: Zhiwei Xue, Junzhi Liu, Wenchen Xing, Feiyu Mu, Yanzhao Wu, Jiangli Zhao, Xuchen Liu, Donghai Wang, Jian Wang, Xingang Li, Jiwei Wang, Bin Huang
pmc-11481566.description: BackgroundExosomes (EXO) play crucial roles in intercellular communication and glioma microenvironment modulation. Tumor-associated macrophages are more likely to become M2-like type macrophages in the immunosuppressive microenvironment. Here, we aimed to investigate the effects and molecular mechanisms of hypoxic glioma-derived exosomes mediated M2-like macrophage polarization.

pmc-11710158.title: Association between Hippocampal Volume and Cognition in the Oldest‐Old Individuals from Colombia
pmc-11710158.creator: Elizabeth Kaplan, Yesica Zuluaga, Daniel Vasquez, Liliana Hincapie, David Fernando Aguillon, Lucia Madrigal, Ana Y Baena, Clara Vila‐Castelar, Sergio Alvarez, Martin Ochoa‐Escudero, Margarita M. Giraldo‐Chica, Liliana A Ramirez Gomez, Stephanie Langella, Joseph F Arboleda‐Velasquez, Francisco Lopera
pmc-11710158.description: BackgroundLife expectancy is on the rise, accompanied by an increased prevalence of cognitive impairment and Alzheimer’s disease. Despite this global trend, our understanding of the neural mechanisms underlying cognitive changes in the oldest‐old (>80 years old) population remains limited. Unraveling these mechanisms may provide valuable insights and therapeutic interventions for individuals grappling with cognitive impairments in older age.

pmc-12785609.title: Microplastics, Endocrine Disruptors, and Oxidative Stress: Mechanisms and Health Implications
pmc-12785609.creator: Kalman Kovacs, Jozsef Bodis, Reka A. Vass
pmc-12785609.description: Microplastics and nanoplastics (<5 mm and <1 μm, respectively) are emerging contaminants now ubiquitous across environmental matrices and increasingly recognized for their impacts on human health. These particles commonly adsorb or contain endocrine-disrupting chemicals—such as bisphenol-A and phthalate additives—that together trigger complex biological responses.

pmc-13079916.title: Vitamin E fails to prevent bisphenol S induced testicular damage in diabetic rats
pmc-13079916.creator: Sheila I. Peña-Corona, Juan I. Chávez-Corona, Olga V. Ruiz-García, Claudia Fernández-Diez, José L. Cerbón-Gutiérrez, Dinorah Vargas-Estrada, José Pedraza-Chaverri, Socorro Retana-Márquez, Alonso Sierra-Reséndiz, David Quintanar-Guerrero, Gerardo Leyva-Gómez, Javad Sharifi-Rad, C. Adriana Mendoza-Rod
pmc-13079916.description: Bisphenol S (BPS) is a recognized environmental contaminant that harms reproductive organs and fertility, affecting human health worldwide. Over the last few decades, the search for a compound that mitigates its harmful effects has increased. Vitamin E has not been evaluated in diabetic rats as a study model.

pmc-13222886.title: Disentangled autoencoding equivariant diffusion model for controlled generation of 3D molecules
pmc-13222886.creator: Tianxiao Li, Haoran Liu, Hongyu Guo, Mark Gerstein, Martin Renqiang Min
pmc-13222886.description: Controlled generation of 3D molecules is highly valuable in drug design, enabling targeted modifications that preserve core structure and binding-relevant geometry while improving developability-related properties. While equivariant diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art de novo 3D molecule generation, reliably controlling multiple molecular properties remains challenging. A key limitation is structural: diffusion models typically lack an explicit latent space for targeted manipulation.

pmc-13326647.title: Evaluation of retinal and choroidal microvasculature parameters by OCTA in patients with premature ovarian insufficiency: a prospective case control study
pmc-13326647.creator: Serdar Ozer, Abdullah Beyoglu, Alev Ozer
pmc-13326647.description: ObjectivePostmenopausal cohorts show reduced vessel density on optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA), yet OCTA data specific to premature ovarian insufficiency (POI) are lacking. We aimed to characterize retinal and choroidal microvasculature in women with POI using OCTA and to compare these findings with age-matched women with regular menses.

pmc-13353795.title: Pressure Alopecia in a Pediatric Patient: A Case Report
pmc-13353795.creator: Karen Sanchez-Tamayo, Roxana Castañeda-Yépiz, Mariana Pérez-Chavez, Luis Guillermo Patiño-Gutiérrez, Esperanza Sañudo-Vallejo

pmc-13477271.creator: Mumtaz Begum, Lynne Giles, Alice Rumbold, Renae Fernandez, Michael Davies, Vivienne Moore

pmc-13542012.title: Peri-prosthetic soft tissue considerations in periodontology and implantology: biological basis, clinical relevance, and contemporary perspectives
pmc-13542012.creator: Pavithra R., Vinita A. Boloor, Rajesh K. S., Anupama Rao
pmc-13542012.description: BackgroundPeri-prosthetic soft tissues play a critical role in maintaining biologic stability, functional longevity, and esthetic outcomes of restorative and implant therapy. Rather than acting as passive barriers, these tissues function as dynamic biologic interfaces that respond to restorative procedures, prosthetic contours, and mechanical influences.

pmc-13628039.title: Using Natural Language Processing to Examine State Child Maltreatment Policies and Associations With Outcomes: Multistate Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13628039.creator: Zhidi Luo, Richard A Epstein, Nethra Sambamoorthi, Lutfiyya N Muhammad, Neil Jordan
pmc-13628039.description: BackgroundChild maltreatment is a major public health issue in the United States, with substantial variation in how states define, report, and respond to abuse and neglect. While prior research has examined individual policy components, less is known about how multiple policies jointly shape broader policy environments and relate to maltreatment outcomes.

pmc-13670698.title: The role of fluid restriction in acute bacterial meningitis: A systematic review
pmc-13670698.creator: M Netravathi, Debjyoti Dhar, Thuppanattumadam Ananthasubramanian Sangeeth, Nicoline Schiess, Francesco Venuti, Nicolò Binello, Kavita Kothari, Tarun Dua
pmc-13670698.description: BackgroundAcute bacterial meningitis (ABM) is a neurological emergency that requires prompt and appropriate antibiotics and corticosteroids. Previously fluid restriction was recommended in the treatment of ABM in view of studies reporting hyponatremia which was due to elevated antidiuretic hormone (ADH) levels.
